full_track.tags: K-Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic pattern in G Major at 105 BPM. A soft, dry kick drum and shaker provide a steady pulse. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar progression with a warm, rounded tone. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, conversational style with light doubling and subtle plate reverb. A bright, percussive synth pluck enters during the chorus, doubling the vocal melody. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar and the vocal phrasing.
